title: The safest next text
hook: The safest next text starts with knowing what you actually need.
body_or_script: Before you send, ask whether you need expression, clarity, reassurance, or a boundary.
caption: Know the need before the next text.
notes: Manual publish only after Day007 checklist is clear.

title: Expression clarity or anxiety
hook: Are you expressing, asking for clarity, or calming anxiety?
body_or_script: The same words can land differently depending on the need behind them. Name the need before you choose the message.
caption: Name the need first.
notes: Manual publish only after Day007 checklist is clear.

title: Clear is not chasing
hook: A clear message is not the same as a chasing message.
body_or_script: Clarity respects both people. Chasing tries to force relief. Pause long enough to know which one you are doing.
caption: Clear is not chasing.
notes: Manual publish only after Day007 checklist is clear.
